# OpenSpace User Meeting
_Thursday, July 31 - Friday, August 1_

Join us in NYC this summer for our first in-person OpenSpace User Meeting! OpenSpace users of all levels are invited to the American Museum of Natural History for two days of trainings, presentations, and hands-on sessions. This is a great opportunity to:

  - Sharpen your OpenSpace skills
  - Explore the latest software features and updates
  - Connect with educators, planetarium professionals, researchers, and developers in the OpenSpace community
  - Breakfast and lunch will be provided.

_Registration has closed._
